headline: CSU Pueblo drop their first points at Colorado Mesa
dek: CSU Pueblo's draw at Colorado Mesa was their first match without a win this season, after seven straight victories. They remain the only side in the conference yet to lose, and have conceded four goals all season.
displaced_by: CSU Pueblo drew at Colorado Mesa: the standing dek's 'yet to drop a point' and 'seven wins from seven' no longer hold
